products.name: Holistic AI
products.note: Bias auditing, risk management, compliance; strong technical depth; mid-market focus

reading.body:
Holistic AI addresses a gap between AI deployment speed and organizational visibility. The company builds tools to find every AI system in use across an organization, test them for safety and bias, and maintain compliance with multiple regulatory frameworks, positioning itself in a market where AI scaling outpaces governance infrastructure.

The platform's scope reflects a real problem in large enterprises: AI systems proliferate faster than IT teams can track them. Shadow AI, undocumented deployments, and fragmented ownership create risk that neither traditional software governance nor manual auditing can contain. Holistic AI's approach of automated discovery, continuous testing, and real-time monitoring for agentic systems addresses the operational side of this constraint. As organizations deploy more AI systems, governance tools become part of the cost structure for scaling safely.

This data does not reveal adoption rates, deployment timelines, or whether the platform materially affects how fast enterprises can actually build and deploy AI. It also does not cover whether governance tools themselves become a constraint on AI scaling, or whether they primarily reduce risk within existing deployment patterns. The company's stated focus on mid-market organizations suggests a gap between what enterprises need and what they can currently afford or implement at scale.

profile_text.body:
Holistic AI describes itself as an enterprise AI governance platform. Its product, also named Holistic AI, is presented as an end-to-end tool for identifying, protecting, and enforcing AI governance at scale. The company says the platform discovers AI models, agents, and applications across cloud, code, and SaaS environments, assesses risk, enforces policies, and generates compliance evidence for security, legal, and board audiences. It also describes a supervisory layer for agentic AI that observes actions, evaluates them against policies, and intervenes when risk thresholds are crossed.

The site cites third-party recognition from Everest Group, CB Insights, Avasant, and Forrester, and includes quotes from Unilever and MindBridge describing use of the platform for AI assurance and risk classification. The product covers bias auditing, risk management, and compliance, with a mid-market focus. No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded for the company.
